notes: Ruka 0.4.11: edit saved memory. The Memory page now has an inline edit control for existing facts, keeps the original source, records an edited timestamp, and refuses duplicate text. This fixes the old workflow where a wrong remembered fact had to be deleted and re-added. The CEF fallback supports the same edit. Includes the 0.4.10 agent fixes: acceptance gating, file scope, context trimming, stream errors and text tool-call parsing.
